x: The much-discussed Novice Walk, after much advertising and splendid response from certain of our Club officials who presented the prizes was, from a numerical point of view, a failure. Consolation was found, however, in the splendid racing that followed G. Tucker, the winner, walked a brainy race against L J.

Khlopin and G Tucker were our only representatives at Croydon for the Surrey Walking Club's "Godstone" walk, and Tommy was unfortunate enough to arrive late and so he started 11 mins. 32 secs. after the rest of the field and yet managed to get fifth in the scratch race.
